messages.subject: smooth line values
parts:
Hi - Can anyone tell me how to print out the values ggplot2 uses for
its smooth lines?

So I've got my ggplot of x and y, then add a smooth line like so:
> ... + geom_smooth(data = data, method="lm", formula = y ~ ns(x,10))"

Which works fine and adds a smooth line to the plot. But then I need
to know what values are used for the line (so I can calculate the
distance from the smooth line on another set of data)

I've done this:
> stat <- lm(formula = y ~ ns(x, 10), data=data)
and then:
> summary(stat)

But cannot see how the stats in this match with the smooth line in any
way .. Sorry if this is a really straightforward thing to work out,
but I am stuck. Please help!

Andrew

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: smooth line values
parts:
?coef()

This should give you the components of the equation for the line. 

Assuming y = mx + b


b = coef(stat)[1]

m = coef(stat)[2]


B
